title: GEP Gene
description: A reusable evolution strategy in the Genome Evolution Protocol

routing_hint.description: Optional EvoX-side routing hints consumed by the gene -> router/tool-gate pipeline. Absent or empty (no recognized keys) means 'no opinion'; the router takes its historical fast path.

tool_policy.description: Optional EvoX-side tool gate. When a list is present, severity defaults to 'warn'. An empty allow_only is invalid (it would block every tool), so producers MUST omit empty lists.

claims.description: Optional machine-decidable claims this gene asserts. Each claim is one coordinate of the five-coordinate evidence projection: what the gene guarantees, in a form a verifier can check. Absent means 'no explicit claim' — the gene projects only under its asset_id. Producers that cannot state a decidable claim MUST omit this rather than emit a vague string.

scope.description: Optional machine-decidable scope predicate — the coordinate that bounds where a claim holds. Keys must come from the runtime signal vocabulary (not free-form), so the resolver can decide membership. Absent means 'unscoped' (projects everywhere), which keeps the gene OUT of the strict K_auto subdomain.

signals.description: Runtime signal tokens the scope is expressed over (resolver-vocabulary, not source identifiers).

predicate.description: Decidable scope expression over the signals, e.g. 'matches(rounding-v2)'.

runtime_profile.description: Optional runtime coordinate — the execution environment class under which the gene's claims were established and are expected to hold. Absent means 'runtime-agnostic'.

verifier_profile.description: Optional verifier coordinate — the verifier under whose judgement the claims were checked. Verifier-specific projection uses this axis; absent means 'no verifier binding' and disqualifies the record from strict K_auto.

skills_required.description: Optional Skill Store skills this gene's strategy depends on. A consumer that installs the gene as a skill installs each listed skill (its SKILL.md and bundled files) alongside it, and refuses the install when one of them cannot be delivered. Absent means the gene needs no skill. Producers with nothing to require MUST omit the key; an empty array is invalid.

type.description: Where the skill lives. 'internal' is the Hub's Skill Store; no other source is defined.

name.description: Human-readable skill name, for display only.

version.description: Pins the skill version the gene was written against. A consumer that receives a different version refuses the install.
